name: Pay 7
author: aswinkumarbaskar

sections.description:
Our project is a cutting-edge payment gateway designed to seamlessly accept cryptocurrency payments.
It offers businesses and merchants an easy, secure, and efficient way to integrate crypto transactions into their existing payment systems.
By supporting a wide range of popular cryptocurrencies, the platform ensures fast, low-cost, and borderless payments, empowering both consumers and businesses to transact with digital assets in a simple, reliable, and user-friendly environment.
Whether you’re a retailer, service provider, or online merchant, our payment gateway helps you tap into the rapidly growing market of cryptocurrency users while ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.

External services

Initiating the Request: The user starts by initiating a deposit fund request through our platform. This request generates a unique transaction for the cryptocurrency deposit, ensuring a seamless and secure payment process.

Payment Processing: The user makes the payment through their preferred cryptocurrency method. The platform acts as a third-party intermediary, securely managing the transaction to ensure that all information remains encrypted and confidential.

Transaction Verification: After completing the payment, the user can click the “Check User” button to verify the payment status. Our platform checks the transaction against the blockchain network to confirm whether the payment has been successfully processed.

Payment Success: If the payment is successful, the user will be automatically redirected to the respective site to complete the transaction or continue the process. The redirection happens only after the payment is confirmed, ensuring the user’s action is legitimate.

Payment Failure: If the payment is unsuccessful, the user will remain on the same page with a clear notification indicating the failure. The user can then retry the payment or take any necessary action to resolve the issue.
Please review our terms and conditions before using our service – https://pay7.maticz.in/termsandconditions.
Learn how we protect and manage your data – https://pay7.maticz.in/privacypolicy.
sections.installation:
This section describes how to install the plugin and get it working.
1. Upload Pay7 for Woocommerce https://github.com/maticz-admin/pay-woocommerce to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory

  1. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
